titulo: En la tienda de la vereda
rol_tutor: Camila, a friendly customer who visits the village store where the learner is the shopkeeper
meta_es: Tú eres el tendero: recibe a una clienta, dile qué tienes y qué no tienes, cobra y da el vuelto.
meta_final_es: Hoy vendiste tomates en inglés y dijiste lo que no tenías.

pasos.tutor: Good morning! Is this your store?
pasos.ayuda_es: Eres el tendero: recibe a la clienta. Ej.: Good morning! Welcome to my store.
opciones: Good morning! Welcome to my store.
Hello! Yes, this is my store.
Hi! How can I help you?

pasos.tutor: Nice! Do you have tomatoes?
pasos.ayuda_es: Responde si tienes tomates. Ej.: Yes, I have tomatoes.
opciones: Yes, I have tomatoes.
Yes, of course.
Yes, we have fresh tomatoes.

pasos.tutor: Great! I want two kilos, please. How much is it?
pasos.ayuda_es: Dile cuánto cuesta. Ej.: It is six thousand pesos.
opciones: It is six thousand pesos.
Six thousand pesos.
It costs six thousand pesos.

pasos.tutor: Perfect. Do you have lemons too?
pasos.ayuda_es: Hoy no hay limones. Di que no tienes, con don't. Ej.: Sorry, I don't have lemons.
opciones: Sorry, I don't have lemons.
No, I don't have lemons today.
I don't have lemons, but I have oranges.

pasos.tutor: Oh, no problem. What can I buy instead?
pasos.ayuda_es: Ofrece otra cosa que sí tienes. Ej.: You can buy oranges.
opciones: You can buy oranges.
I have bananas and oranges.
Try the oranges. They are good.

pasos.tutor: OK, I take the oranges. Here is twenty thousand pesos. Do you have change?
pasos.ayuda_es: Di que sí y da el vuelto. Ej.: Yes, here is your change.
opciones: Yes, here is your change.
Sure! Your change is four thousand pesos.
Of course. Thank you!

pasos.tutor: Thank you! Your store is very nice. See you soon!
pasos.ayuda_es: Despídete de la clienta. Ej.: Thank you! Have a nice day!
opciones: Thank you! Have a nice day!
Goodbye! See you soon.
You are welcome. See you tomorrow!

rol_tutor: Laura, a kind human-resources interviewer at a software and animation company
meta_es: Consigue el trabajo: preséntate, di tu edad, tus estudios, tus habilidades y un proyecto del año pasado.
meta_final_es: Hoy hiciste una entrevista completa en inglés y dijiste tu edad bien.

pasos.tutor: Hello, welcome! Please sit down. How are you?
pasos.ayuda_es: Saluda con cortesía. Ej.: Hello! I am fine, thank you.
opciones: Hello! I am fine, thank you.
Good morning! I am very well.
Hi! I am a little nervous, but fine.

pasos.tutor: Thank you for coming. How old are you?
pasos.ayuda_es: Di tu edad con am, no con have. Ej.: I am 24 years old.
opciones: I am 24 years old.
I am twenty years old.
I'm 30 years old.

pasos.tutor: And where do you live?
pasos.ayuda_es: Di dónde vives. Ej.: I live in Málaga.
opciones: I live in Málaga.
I live in Concepción.
I live in a village near Málaga.

pasos.tutor: What do you study at SENA?
pasos.ayuda_es: Cuenta tu programa. Ej.: I study software development at SENA.
opciones: I study software development at SENA.
I study digital animation.
I am a SENA student.

pasos.tutor: Interesting! What can you do with your tools?
pasos.ayuda_es: Di qué sabes hacer y qué herramientas usas. Ej.: I can make websites. I use Python.
opciones: I can make websites. I use Python.
I can draw characters. I use Blender.
I can write code and I use SQL.

pasos.tutor: Tell me about a project you made last year.
pasos.ayuda_es: Usa el pasado: made, built, wrote, learned. Ej.: Last year I made a website for my family.
opciones: Last year I made a website for my family.
I built a small game with my team.
I wrote a program and I learned a lot.

pasos.tutor: Very good. Do you have a question for me?
pasos.ayuda_es: Haz una pregunta sobre el trabajo. Ej.: What time does the job start?
opciones: What time does the job start?
Where is the office?
Do I work on Saturdays?

pasos.tutor: Thank you for your time. We will call you soon. Goodbye!
pasos.ayuda_es: Despídete y da las gracias. Ej.: Thank you! Goodbye.
opciones: Thank you! Goodbye.
Thank you for your time. See you soon!
Thanks, Laura. Have a nice day!

rol_tutor: Sam, a curious visitor at a SENA technology fair
meta_es: Muéstrale tu proyecto a un visitante: qué es, para qué sirve, cómo lo hiciste y qué sigue.
meta_final_es: Hoy presentaste tu proyecto en inglés, de principio a fin.

pasos.tutor: Hi! This looks interesting. What is your project?
pasos.ayuda_es: Di qué es tu proyecto. Ej.: My project is an app for farmers.
opciones: My project is an app for farmers.
It is a website for my town.
My project is a short animation.

pasos.tutor: Cool! Who is it for, and how does it help?
pasos.ayuda_es: Usa to + verbo: It helps people to… Ej.: It helps farmers to sell coffee.
opciones: It helps farmers to sell coffee.
It is for students. It helps them to study.
It helps people to find a job.

pasos.tutor: Why did you decide to make it?
pasos.ayuda_es: Usa want to / need to + verbo. Ej.: I wanted to help my family.
opciones: I wanted to help my family.
Because I want to learn.
We needed to solve a problem in my town.

pasos.tutor: Which tools did you use to make it?
pasos.ayuda_es: Cuenta en pasado qué herramientas usaste. Ej.: We used Python and a database.
opciones: We used Python and a database.
I made it with Blender.
We worked three months with HTML.

pasos.tutor: It looks difficult. What was the biggest problem?
pasos.ayuda_es: Cuenta un problema. Ej.: The hardest part was the database.
opciones: The hardest part was the database.
Yes, it was hard. We had many errors.
The biggest problem was the internet.

pasos.tutor: What do you want to do next with your project?
pasos.ayuda_es: Habla del futuro con want to / hope to. Ej.: Next year I want to add more users.
opciones: Next year I want to add more users.
I want to improve the design.
We hope to sell it to farmers.

pasos.tutor: Amazing work! Good luck with your project. Bye!
pasos.ayuda_es: Agradece y despídete. Ej.: Thank you! Bye!
opciones: Thank you! Bye!
Thanks, Sam. See you soon!
Thank you! Have a nice day.

titulo: En la plaza de mercado de Málaga
rol_tutor: Rosa, a friendly vendor at the Málaga market who sells potatoes, onions and blackberries
meta_es: Compra verduras y fruta en la plaza: saluda, pide con a/an, di cuántos kilos, pregunta el total y paga.
meta_final_es: Hoy hiciste tu mercado completo en inglés, con a y an bien puestos.

pasos.tutor: Good morning! Welcome to the Málaga market. How are you?
pasos.ayuda_es: Saluda a Rosa. Ej.: Good morning! I am fine, thank you.
opciones: Good morning! I am fine, thank you.
Hello, Rosa! I am very well.
Hi! I am fine, and you?

pasos.tutor: What do you need today?
pasos.ayuda_es: Pide con a / an: a kilo of, an onion. Ej.: I need a kilo of potatoes and an onion.
opciones: I need a kilo of potatoes and an onion.
I want a bag of blackberries.
I need a kilo of potatoes, please.

pasos.tutor: How many kilos of potatoes?
pasos.ayuda_es: Di cuántos kilos. Ej.: Two kilos, please.
opciones: Two kilos, please.
Three kilos.
Half a kilo, please.

pasos.tutor: We have fresh blackberries. Do you want some?
pasos.ayuda_es: Acepta o rechaza. Ej.: Yes, please. I want a bag of blackberries.
opciones: Yes, please. I want a bag of blackberries.
No, thank you.
Yes, I want half a kilo.

pasos.tutor: Here you are. The potatoes are five thousand pesos. Anything else?
pasos.ayuda_es: Pregunta cuánto es en total. Ej.: That is all, thank you. How much is it?
opciones: That is all, thank you. How much is it?
How much is it in total?
No, thanks. What is the total?

pasos.tutor: It is thirteen thousand pesos in total. Do you have exact money?
pasos.ayuda_es: Paga o pide el vuelto. Ej.: Yes, here you are.
opciones: Yes, here you are.
Sorry, I have a fifty thousand bill. Do you have change?
I have twenty thousand pesos.

pasos.tutor: Thank you! Come back soon. Have a nice day!
pasos.ayuda_es: Despídete de Rosa. Ej.: Thank you, Rosa. See you next week!
opciones: Thank you, Rosa. See you next week!
Goodbye! Have a nice day.
Thanks! See you soon.

rol_tutor: Emma, a tourist who visits the learner's farm for a night
meta_es: Recibe a una turista en tu finca: muestra los animales, el cuarto, la comida y las actividades.
meta_final_es: Hoy fuiste anfitrión de una turista en inglés y usaste bien has y gives.

pasos.tutor: Hello! What a beautiful farm! Is this your home?
pasos.ayuda_es: Dale la bienvenida. Ej.: Welcome to my farm!
opciones: Welcome to my farm!
Hello! Yes, this is my family farm.
Hi! Welcome to our home.

pasos.tutor: What is on your farm?
pasos.ayuda_es: Di qué tienes en la finca. Ej.: We have cows, chickens and coffee.
opciones: We have cows, chickens and coffee.
I have two horses and a garden.
There are many trees and a small river.

pasos.tutor: Nice! Tell me about one animal. What does it do?
pasos.ayuda_es: Con it / he / she el verbo lleva -s: gives, eats. Ej.: My cow gives milk every day.
opciones: My cow gives milk every day.
The horse eats grass and runs fast.
Our dog sleeps near the door.

pasos.tutor: I want to stay tonight. What does the room have?
pasos.ayuda_es: Describe el cuarto con has. Ej.: The room has two beds and a bathroom.
opciones: The room has two beds and a bathroom.
Yes! The room has a big window and hot water.
The house has a kitchen and a nice view.

pasos.tutor: Great! What do we eat for breakfast?
pasos.ayuda_es: Cuenta qué se come en el desayuno. Ej.: We eat eggs, arepa and hot chocolate.
opciones: We eat eggs, arepa and hot chocolate.
Breakfast has coffee, bread and cheese.
My mother makes arepas and coffee.

pasos.tutor: What can I do here tomorrow?
pasos.ayuda_es: Propón una actividad con You can… Ej.: You can ride a horse.
opciones: You can ride a horse.
You can pick coffee with my father.
You can walk to the river.

pasos.tutor: Wonderful! How much is one night?
pasos.ayuda_es: Di el precio por noche en pesos. Ej.: One night is eighty thousand pesos.
opciones: One night is eighty thousand pesos.
It is sixty thousand pesos with breakfast.
It costs fifty thousand pesos.

pasos.tutor: Thank you! I love this place. Good night!
pasos.ayuda_es: Despídete de la turista. Ej.: You are welcome! Enjoy your stay.
opciones: You are welcome! Enjoy your stay.
Thank you! Have a good night.
Welcome! See you at breakfast.

rol_tutor: Mr. Gómez, a customer whose old laptop is slow, who visits the learner's repair workshop
meta_es: Eres el técnico: pregunta qué pasa, explica el problema, di cómo lo arreglas, cuánto tarda y cuánto cuesta.
meta_final_es: Hoy diagnosticaste y arreglaste un computador en inglés.

pasos.tutor: Hello. I have a problem with my laptop. Can you help me?
pasos.ayuda_es: Recibe al cliente. Ej.: Hello! Yes, I can help you.
opciones: Hello! Yes, I can help you.
Good morning! What is the problem?
Sure, tell me about the problem.

pasos.tutor: My laptop is very slow. Sometimes the screen is black. What do you want to know?
pasos.ayuda_es: Haz una pregunta para entender el problema. Ej.: When is the screen black?
opciones: When is the screen black?
Is it new or old?
Does it turn on?

pasos.tutor: It is five years old. Why is it so slow?
pasos.ayuda_es: Explica la causa. No olvides it is. Ej.: It is slow because the disk is full.
opciones: It is slow because the disk is full.
It is old and the memory is small.
It is a virus problem.

pasos.tutor: I see. What do you do first to fix it?
pasos.ayuda_es: Cuenta tu plan con First… Then… Ej.: First, I check the disk.
opciones: First, I check the disk.
I delete old files and I scan for viruses.
First I make a backup. Then I clean it.

pasos.tutor: OK. How long does it take, and how much is it?
pasos.ayuda_es: Di el tiempo y el precio. Ej.: It takes two hours and it is thirty thousand pesos.
opciones: It takes two hours and it is thirty thousand pesos.
It is ready tomorrow. It is twenty thousand pesos.
It takes one day. It costs forty thousand pesos.

pasos.tutor: Good. How can I keep it fast after you fix it?
pasos.ayuda_es: Da un consejo. Ej. con Please… o Do not… Ej.: Please update Windows and use an antivirus.
opciones: Please update Windows and use an antivirus.
Do not install strange programs.
Make a backup and delete old files.

pasos.tutor: Thank you so much! Is it ready now?
pasos.ayuda_es: Dile que ya está listo. Ej.: Yes! It is ready and it is fast now.
opciones: Yes! It is ready and it is fast now.
It is fixed. You are welcome!
Yes, it is working now.

titulo: Indicaciones a un turista en Málaga
rol_tutor: Tom, a tourist who just arrived in Málaga and does not know the town
meta_es: Ayuda a un turista: dile cómo llegar a la plaza, qué ve en el camino, dónde comer y qué visitar.
meta_final_es: Hoy guiaste a un turista por Málaga en inglés y describiste lugares con el orden correcto.

pasos.tutor: Excuse me! I am a tourist. Can you help me?
pasos.ayuda_es: Dile que sí. Ej.: Yes, of course!
opciones: Yes, of course!
Sure! What do you need?
Hello! How can I help you?

pasos.tutor: Thank you! Where is the main square?
pasos.ayuda_es: Dile cómo llegar: go straight, block. Ej.: Go straight for two blocks.
opciones: Go straight for two blocks.
Walk straight and turn left.
Go straight, then turn right.

pasos.tutor: Okay, two blocks. And then?
pasos.ayuda_es: Dile hacia dónde girar. Ej.: Turn left at the corner.
opciones: Turn left at the corner.
Then turn right.
Turn left and cross the street.

pasos.tutor: What can I see there to know it?
pasos.ayuda_es: Describe un lugar: opinión, tamaño, edad, color. Ej.: You can see a big white church.
opciones: You can see a big white church.
There is a beautiful old church.
You see a small green park.

pasos.tutor: Great! I am hungry. Is there a good restaurant near the square?
pasos.ayuda_es: Recomienda un lugar para comer. Ej.: Yes, there is a nice small restaurant.
opciones: Yes, there is a nice small restaurant.
Try the typical food. It is delicious.
There is a nice small restaurant next to the church.

pasos.tutor: I have one more day. What is a good place to visit near Málaga?
pasos.ayuda_es: Recomienda un lugar: páramo, Concepción, el mercado. Ej.: Visit the páramo del Almorzadero. It is a beautiful cold place.
opciones: Visit the páramo del Almorzadero. It is a beautiful cold place.
You can go to Concepción. It is a nice small town.
Go to the market. It is a big busy place.

pasos.tutor: Thank you very much! You are very kind. Goodbye!
pasos.ayuda_es: Despídete del turista. Ej.: You are welcome! Enjoy Málaga.
opciones: You are welcome! Enjoy Málaga.
Goodbye! Have a nice trip.
Enjoy your stay in Málaga!

rol_tutor: Mia, a curious visitor at a student animation and games showcase at SENA
meta_es: Muéstrale a una visitante la animación o el videojuego que hiciste: personaje, proceso, dificultades y qué aprendiste.
meta_final_es: Hoy contaste cómo hiciste tu animación o juego, en pasado y en inglés.

pasos.tutor: Hi! What a cool screen. What did you make?
pasos.ayuda_es: Di qué hiciste. Ej.: I made a short animation.
opciones: I made a short animation.
I made a game about a farmer.
I created a 3D character.

pasos.tutor: Wow! Who is the main character?
pasos.ayuda_es: Presenta al personaje principal. Ej.: The main character is a young farmer.
opciones: The main character is a young farmer.
He is a small robot called Pepe.
Her name is Luna. She is a brave girl.

pasos.tutor: I love the style. How did you draw it?
pasos.ayuda_es: Usa el pasado: drew, made, used, wrote. Ej.: I drew it on paper first.
opciones: I drew it on paper first.
I made the model in Blender.
I used Krita and I drew every scene.

pasos.tutor: How long did it take?
pasos.ayuda_es: Di cuánto tiempo te tomó: took. Ej.: It took three months.
opciones: It took three months.
I worked two weeks every night.
It took about one month.

pasos.tutor: What was the hardest part?
pasos.ayuda_es: Cuenta qué fue lo más difícil. Ej.: The hardest part was the sound.
opciones: The hardest part was the sound.
I had a problem with the rendering.
The hardest part was the walking animation.

pasos.tutor: What did you learn?
pasos.ayuda_es: Usa learned, found, knew. Ej.: I learned a lot about light.
opciones: I learned a lot about light.
I found a new way to animate.
I learned that practice is important.

pasos.tutor: I love it! Where can people see it?
pasos.ayuda_es: Dile dónde se puede ver o jugar. Ej.: People can watch it on YouTube.
opciones: People can watch it on YouTube.
You can play it on my website.
You can see it here and on my phone.

pasos.tutor: Great work! Thank you for showing me. Goodbye!
pasos.ayuda_es: Agradece y despídete. Ej.: Thank you! Come back next year.
opciones: Thank you! Come back next year.
Thanks for watching! Goodbye.
Thank you, Mia! See you soon.
